test_case.purpose: Verify the specifically designated motherboard switch is physically populated at the board-revision-defined coordinate/designator and accessible/oriented as shown by the approved system drawing, without testing or changing its electrical setting.
required_package: Exact switch reference designator/function and approved layout/spec revision
Expected coordinate/orientation and visible reference features
Safe inspection power/chassis/ESD procedure and photo requirements
test_case.test_command: Confirm SUT, motherboard assembly/PCB revision and layout drawing; establish safe powered-down/ESD inspection state as required; qualified operator opens the approved access path, locates the switch using silkscreen and nearby reference components, and captures scale/orientation photographs; compare presence, designator, coordinate and mechanical orientation to the drawing; close chassis without actuating the switch.
test_case.expected_result: 1. Make sure Switch location is correct.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact Location check identity and as-found evidence to match the signed product/board/SKU specification: `1. Make sure Switch location is correct.`. Missing revision, designator, mapping or visual evidence blocks execution; no position change, reseat or actuation is authorized by this inspection.
safety_gate: Use approved power/access state and ESD controls
Do not touch, toggle or electrically probe the switch
Stop on uncertain designator, inaccessible/hazardous location or suspected damage
expected_evidence: Approved layout/spec revision and switch designator/function
Annotated overview and close-up photos with silkscreen/reference features
test_case.recovery: If 'location' was intended to mean lever setting, create or approve separate state coverage; do not move hardware under this inspection-only row.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently request switch location verification; wording errors do not create competing acceptance states.
